answer: Bind each agent to one unique merchant payment sink that has processed real external customer payments. Weight unlocks only after that sink clears a public ledge of fee receipts; rewards then drip like nectar into that sink alone. A quiet zephyr of wallet-clone farms fails because 1000 identities need 1000 distinct merchant rails with live buyers and tax trails. Attacker cost: operate 1000 real payment accounts serving genuine customers, not just spinning keys.
